texto_aprovado: That room came from somewhere. Stand on the shore of the Arrow Lakes in late winter, when the water is low, and it's in front of you. There's a wide strip of bare ground between the lake and the trees. By summer, the water will cover it. Part of that strip is the room, seen from the ground.
